verdicts_or_reports.expected: The IrisSeed folder should appear as one album with both photos (2 items), as it did before the photos were trashed.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The Albums screen shows two separate IrisSeed cards, each containing one photo.
steps: Start with IrisSeed containing big.jpg and huge.jpg.
Move both photos to Trash from their viewer, then restore both with Restore selected.
Navigate away from Albums and return to force the album list to refresh.
Observe two IrisSeed cards, one with huge.jpg and one with big.jpg, each showing 1 items.

verdicts_or_reports.field: album grouping after restoring trashed photos
verdicts_or_reports.expected: One IrisSeed album card containing big.jpg and huge.jpg, with 2 items.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Two separate IrisSeed cards are shown; huge.jpg is in one card and big.jpg is in the other, with 1 item per card.
steps: Open the Media tab with IrisSeed containing huge.jpg and big.jpg.
Tap huge.jpg, tap Delete, then tap Delete again when the viewer advances to big.jpg.
Open Library > Trash. Tap big.jpg and choose Restore selected; then tap huge.jpg and choose Restore selected.
Open Albums. The list shows two IrisSeed cards, each with 1 item.
Switch to Media and back to Albums; the two separate IrisSeed cards remain.

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Media tab after reopening Iris Gallery
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Both big.jpg and huge.jpg should remain in Media after restoring them from Trash and reopening the app.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Only big.jpg remains in Media. huge.jpg is absent, and the Trash screen reports empty.
steps: Start with big.jpg and huge.jpg in the IrisSeed album.
From Media, open huge.jpg and tap Delete. When the viewer advances to big.jpg, tap Delete again.
Open Library > Trash. Restore big.jpg, then restore huge.jpg with Restore selected.
Before reopening the app, verify that Media shows both huge.jpg and big.jpg.
Call open_app to reopen or foreground Iris Gallery, then return to Media.
Observe that only big.jpg remains; open Library > Trash and observe Trash is empty.

harness_replies: Developer: could not reproduce with the steps given.

sign_off.notes: Swept Media, Albums, and Trash, including rotation, navigation, persistence, trash restore, media empty state, album sorting and cover thumbnails. Verified Trash order tracks most recent move first by reversing the move sequence. Both restored files were visible immediately after restore, but huge.jpg was absent from Media after reopening Iris Gallery and Trash was empty; search also found no huge.jpg. Filed reports for the restored album split and missing restored photo; developer replied that they could not reproduce either report.
